title: Captain Tsubasa: An English Tea Highball
ldName: Captain Tsubasa: An English Tea Highball
ldInstructionsRaw: Fill a glass with ice cubes and add a splash of chilled soda. Add the tea syrup and whisky, then fill with more soda. Dash the bitters on top of the drink, then garnish.
English Tea SyrupCombine equal parts strong-steeped English Breakfast tea and granulated sugar, and stir until the sugar dissolves. Keeps refrigerated for up to 1 month.
